item.title: Kaynes Semicon eyes photonics, quantum security and neuromorphic chips in India tech push
item.summary: Kaynes Semicon is looking at silicon photonics (SiPh) and co-packaged optics (CPO), post-quantum security, and neuromorphic computing as potential areas for expansion as India prepares the next phase of its semiconductor support program, CEO Raghu Panicker said.
